sourceResearch.meaning: Pinned uploader version and digest; independently observed on own completed publish Job.
Retained/source/image staging converge on the same publisher.
aws s3 sync uses default MIME guessing; no charset override.
Successful origin read buffers bounded bytes, then copies the Content-Type into Object unchanged.
Object.ContentType is a string and can carry MIME parameters.
One production origin.Get call fills the immutable cache; normalize successful plain UTF8 metadata once here or in S3Origin.Get, not per GET.

sourceResearch.excerpt:
hdr := w.Header()
	hdr.Set("Content-Type", contentType(servedPath, obj.ContentType))
	hdr.Set("Cache-Control", defaultCacheControl)
	// Custom headers win over the defaults above (last-write for a given key).
	applyHeaders(hdr, site.Headers, requestPath)
sourceResearch.meaning: Header defaults use Object MIME, then native custom headers win.
Nonempty text/plain origin metadata wins before MIME-by-extension fallback, preserving the missing charset.
Automatic encoding eligibility discards MIME parameters before matching; UTF8 charset does not change text eligibility.
One production S3Origin/handler wiring; shared by static sites.
